data.reason: Angela, the COO, signed with Adyen after a store operations workshop where we described a till return instead of showing it, had no one who had run a store rollout, and said a partner would do installs. trigger.action: Lead store messaging with the broken cross-channel return: an online order the store can't see or refund at the till.
